column1: # ZAP baseline rules for the target app (a public, static, cookie-less site on a CDN).

column3: (Anti-clickjacking Header: CSP frame-ancestors 'none' is set; losing it is a regression)
(Strict-Transport-Security Header: HSTS is set; losing it is a regression)
(Content Security Policy Header Not Set: a CSP is set; losing it is a regression)
(PII Disclosure: the app must never expose personal data such as card numbers)
(Script served from a known malicious domain)
(CSP: 'unsafe-inline' for script/style: needed by the static export's inline bootstrap; tracked as a hardening item)
(SRI missing on the third-party analytics script: the vendor serves an unversioned file, so SRI would break on update; tracked)

column3: (Cross-domain JS: the one external script is the privacy-friendly analytics counter, allow-listed in the CSP)

(COEP/COOP: the app uses no cross-origin isolation features (SharedArrayBuffer etc.); nothing to isolate)

(Content cacheability: informational; caching is intended for a static site)
